source.code:
/-- An `AddLeftCancelSemigroup` is an additive semigroup such that
`a + b = a + c` implies `b = c`. -/
@[ext]
class AddLeftCancelSemigroup (G : Type u) extends AddSemigroup G, IsLeftCancelAdd G
